source.title: IrelandElection.com, 2025 Seanad Election: University of Dublin
source.check: The count is IrelandElection.com's; the first preferences add up to the valid poll and the 3 winners fill the seats. Each winner was checked against the Houses of the Oireachtas list of the members of the 27th Seanad for this constituency (api.oireachtas.ie, seanad-build, Nov 2026).

franchise: the university's graduates and scholars who are Irish citizens and registered (Seanad Electoral (University Members) Act 1937)
sourceNote: Filed under 2025-01-29, the day the Houses of the Oireachtas give as the start of the 27th Seanad; a Seanad general election is held by post, and its polls close over several days.
